_comment: Hand-verified pin -> source mappings. These win over automatic matching and
Use this when the matcher cannot work it out on its own:
- the pin name carries no town ('Landus coop'),
- the source publishes no coordinates, so geography cannot help,
- or two candidates tie and only you know which is right.
Keys are pin ids: the pin's name lowercased with non-alphanumerics turned
into hyphens. RENAMING A PIN CHANGES ITS ID and orphans the entry here -
match_locations.py warns about entries that match no pin.
source_location_id must match the id the adapter reports. Run
and read scrapers/.build/raw.json to find it.

landus-coop.why: Pin is named 'Landus coop' with no town. It sits at 43.0971,-93.8461, which is Landus's Britt elevator. Landus publishes no coordinates, so neither name nor geo matching can find it.
